author: Nectorist
body:
Disclaimer: This is not me giving away my account.

After a good long run of a few years on Avicus, I will be handing my account over to my 15 year-old cousin. I feel like it is my time to move on. School and everyday life prevent me from doing much on MC, so I see no reason to try to stick around. Thank you all for the great memories, but I need to do things in life other than worrying about playing on a server in some game. I wish you all good luck in your lives. I will not forget the memories here.
